title: Why he is called Bird: a Filipino sailor in the Navy
summary: A Filipino sailor in the Navy could not say Wilbert and called him Bird; his high chest fit.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Well, I was just a nickname, uh, Filipino sailor started to call me when I was in the Navy.

That's, uh, he could never say Wilbert, so he just said, well, I'll call you Bird. And he started to call me Bird, and from then on everybody started calling me Bird. Mm-hmm. That was a Filipino boy, originally, was young. Mm-hmm.
He was trying to say Wilbert and now he could come out with the Bird?
Wasn't it you look like a Bird or anything?
Well, they said I looked like a Bird. Really? Yeah. Yeah. I had a high chest, you know.
